content.title: Confirm deployment, measurement accuracy, power, and communication constraints before component selection
content.description: Validate greenhouse deployment exposure and ingress constraints, acceptable measurement accuracy, sampling/reporting cadence requirements, and remote communication/power feasibility so future component selection stays grounded in confirmed needs.
content.rationale: The current functional architecture can represent unknown constraints as open questions, but selecting specific components for sensing, timing, and remote reporting depends on confirmed deployment and measurement targets.

completionCondition.completionCriteria: Confirm (1) greenhouse deployment environment/ingress expectations, (2) acceptable measurement accuracy/error bounds, (3) sampling and reporting cadence needs, and (4) power-source and remote communication constraints; then mark Q1-Q4 as answered/resolved and proceed to component selection in the next workflow.
